title: Barricades - Pickup/Reset/Replace
description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report barricades that should be picked up, reset or replaced. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 calendar day.
instructions: Call 311 to report barricades that should be picked up, reset, or replaced. This request must be dispatched.

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about a barricade needing pickup, reset, or replacement.
actions.why: Report a barricade that needs to be picked up, reset, or replaced. The description for "Barricades - Pickup/Reset/Replace" requests on the Dallas 311 website says this service must be dispatched by phone.
